model: Fixed / ATLAS adaptive heuristic / density max-pressure / ATLAS constrained search
scope: Published Cologne SUMO network and modeled demand derived from real-world data; simulated interventions, not measured field delay improvements. Held-out demand period and seeds.

methodology.clearance: 3-second yellow + 2-second all red for every phase transition
methodology.fixed: RESCO phase allocation [2,2,8,2,2,2,8,2] at 5-second action interval, with explicit clearance
methodology.adaptive: Production queue-responsive min/max-green rule generalized from two to eight legal Cologne phases, sequential rotation
methodology.max_pressure: Inbound-minus-downstream lane-density pressure over permitted movements; 12-second min green, 60-second max and 180-second demand-bearing starvation bound. A max-pressure variant, not an exact published score reproduction.
methodology.atlas: Same constrained-search approach and vehicle delay/queue/fairness objective; legal eight-phase network adapter, six predeclared timing candidates. No test selection.
methodology.delay: SUMO timeLoss+departDelay for inserted completed/unfinished trips; horizon-depart for not-inserted demand, mean over every scheduled vehicle
methodology.queues: Stopped vehicles (<0.1 m/s) on controlled inbound lanes, not a full network/off-network queue measure
methodology.travel: Completed trips only; completion and unfinished counts included beside it
methodology.pedestrians: Absent from published scenario; no pedestrian wait claim
methodology.demand: Unmodified source trip OD/time windows; same exact schedule and seed paired across controllers; no teleportation
